last.verdict: Investors cheered record R2-driven deliveries and a raised 2026 outlook, looking past heavy cash burn.

reasons.label: Raised 2026 outlook
reasons.text: Delivery goal lifted to 67,000-70,000 and expected loss narrowed by $100 million at midpoint.

reasons.label: R2 takes off
reasons.text: Record 19,248 deliveries, up 46%; new R2 SUV already outsold both R1 and vans.

reasons.label: Software profits grow
reasons.text: Software and services brought in $605 million at a 42% margin, mostly Volkswagen venture work.

story: Deliveries climbed from 10,365 in the first quarter to 19,248 as R2 ramped, and guidance has kept improving. Cash burn stays above $1 billion a quarter. The stock fell 9.6% in July on those worries but rose this time.

history.verdict: Investors sold the stock despite a delivery raise, focusing on cash burn and weak car margins.

reasons.label: Cars still lose money
reasons.text: Automotive gross profit stayed negative at $(36) million, helped by $108 million of regulatory credits.

reasons.label: R2 launch costs
reasons.text: R2 ramp added about $100 million in costs; free cash flow was $(849) million.

reasons.label: Dilution and funding needs
reasons.text: July's $1.3 billion share sale, plus more outside capital needed for the Georgia plant, weighed on the stock.
